title: Capgrader Generator and scanner update
highlights: Capgrader Generator: new Speed and Distance toggles (turn both off to just end with the most money), and it now accounts for the 100-ore limit and slow conveyors like Castle Fortress
Capgrader Generator finds much better chains, with a new three-column layout
Scanners of the same type sweep in sync, so the generator now spaces them out, and every scanner page has a Scanner distance calculator (tested in game at ore size 1)
Azure Scanner hit chances corrected

title: Index page, item pages and search
highlights: Built the Index page: every Dropper, Upgrader, and Furnace as one card with its variants grouped together, plus lots of filters
Every item has its own page: stats, odds, how to get it, and effect/material tags you can hover for info
Index Tiers are up top
Items, potions, and decorations across the wiki link to their own pages, and the search bar works
Added Tornado Alley (with assumed odds)
Fixed a batch of odds and wording issues, including Neon being a material, not an effect

title: Merchant page
highlights: Built the Merchant page: how the Traveling Merchant's personal stock works and everything he can sell, with odds and prices
Finished Ore Processor on the Achievements page
The Base Builder and the Base Design page are hidden for now while the builder gets redesigned

title: Events page
highlights: Built the Events page: how the 15-minute event cycle works, every event's effect and weight, and its real chance of coming up
Filled in Unbox Luck and Friend Luck on the Mastery page
Removed the Crystals Farming tile since it isn't planned

title: Mastery page and Enchanter skip pricing
highlights: Rewrote the README to cover the whole site instead of just the Base Builder
Added skip pricing to the Enchanter page (spend Crystals or Robux to skip an item's remaining enchant time), with a real Robux icon also used on the P2W page
Built out the Mastery page, with icons for the masteries that have one so far
A batch of Achievements data fixes as the real data gets filled in

title: P2W, Enchanter, Furnace Loot and Achievements pages
highlights: Built out the P2W, Enchanter, Furnace Loot, and Achievements pages
Added the home page's update-log panels you're reading now, with a full Game Updates history from the dev's real patch notes
Added Crystals Farming and Base Design tiles
Smaller fixes and polish: broken/missing icons, stale data caching, a real favicon, and clearer section headings

title: Wiki content build-out
highlights: Real page navigation across the home page: all 13 sections, each with its own background art
Full pages for Rebirth, Codes, Conveyor, Decoration, and Brewer
Every reward, code, conveyor piece, decoration, and potion upcraft has real data and its own icon

title: The Wiki goes live
highlights: Added the Wiki tool and made it the site's default landing page
Capgrader Generator results show colored Base/Shiny variant badges, with a twinkling sparkle on Shiny rows

title: Variant mixing and MPA / Chopping Block
highlights: Capgrader Generator chains can mix Base and Shiny copies of the same item (before, it only used the single best owned variant)
Dependency and ordering fixes
Added the MPA / Chopping Block tool

title: MPA / Chopping Block out of WIP
highlights: MPA / Chopping Block graduated out of WIP
Fixed a rotation bug affecting the Base Portable Upgrader
Added 5 new capgraders to the database

title: Bug fixes
highlights: The Calculator tool no longer bleeds into other tools
Stale Capgrader Generator results are cleared after editing your setup

title: Calculator tool
highlights: Added a scientific calculator that understands the game's number abbreviations (K, M, B, T, and beyond)

title: Luck / Crate Simulator
highlights: Added the Luck / Crate Simulator tool
Added a shared help widget for Capgrader Generator and Luck Simulator

title: Site launch
highlights: Capgrader Generator went live
Feedback widget went live: bug reports and suggestions, with image/video attachments
